<description>
It is not entirely accurate that persistent I2P addresses are used for making outbound connections and accepting incoming ones, as the `-privatebroadcast` option forces the use of a new transient destination for each transaction it relays.
</description>

[2026-10-07] rc:4202030598 inline on doc/i2p.md by andrewtoth (member) (edited 2026-10-07):
Might be clearer to use address here instead of destination.

```suggestion
always use a transient address instead (see below).
```
[2026-10-07] rc:4202046621 inline on doc/i2p.md by andrewtoth (member) (edited 2026-10-07):
Similarly

```suggestion
Regardless of `-i2pacceptincoming`, I2P connections opened for
`-privatebroadcast` do not use the persistent address from
`i2p_private_key`. Instead, they use a transient address so the
receiver does not see the node's long-lived I2P identity.
```
